types.name: Types of software and licences
types.description: Asks whether a program is system or application software, open source, freeware, shareware or proprietary, or which program belongs to a suite such as LibreOffice or MS Office.

types.name: Operating systems: types, functions and terms
types.description: Asks what an operating system does, names an OS type (batch, time-sharing, real-time), or defines a term like kernel, spooling, virtual memory, deadlock or BIOS.

types.name: Windows shortcuts and file management
types.description: Asks which Windows key combination opens File Explorer, Task Manager, Properties and so on, or about files, folders, paths and the Recycle Bin.

types.name: Utility programs and system tools
types.description: Names a maintenance tool (antivirus, disk cleanup, defragmenter, backup, compression, Control Panel, Task Manager) and asks what it does.

types.name: Programming languages and translators
types.description: Asks about machine, assembly or high-level languages, or what a compiler, interpreter, assembler, linker or loader does.
